title: Micro-Rehearsal Conductor with Telemetry Heuristics and Safe Surge
author: Aisha Khatri
ci_status: pass (initial failure on smoke_rehearsal_test, rerun succeeded)
description:
Context and motivation: We frequently see two sources of rollout risk for medium-to-large models: (1) hidden amplification when canaries trigger autoscaling spikes and (2) regressions that only surface under slightly different request mixes. Small canaries/chunks are safe but give weak signal; large canaries give better signal but risk capacity and latency regressions. This PR introduces a Micro-Rehearsal Conductor: a lightweight staged-runway that performs short, low-fidelity rehearsals (replay + sampled shadow traffic + smoke evals) before any traffic fraction increase. The conductor automatically holds traffic via a traffic-lease until telemetry heuristics indicate a safe surge. In addition, we add a rollback-oracle that recommends immediate automated reverts if specific telemetry signatures are observed (latency amplification, error-mode bias, quality dip on evals).

What this changes (summary):
- New rehearsal runtime and scheduler (rehearsal/conductor.go) that coordinates micro-rehearsals: create ephemeral rehearsal lanes, replay deterministic sample of recent traffic, and run smoke-evals against pinned prompt sets.
- Telemetry heuristics (telemetry/heuristics.py) that compute surge-safety score using token-latency percentiles, error-code skew, and eval-quality deltas. Heuristics are pluggable and exposed via the rollout API.
- Traffic-lease mechanism (routing/lease_manager.go) that prevents traffic fraction increases until a lease is explicitly approved by the conductor; leases time out to avoid deadlocks.
- Rollback-oracle (rollback/oracle.go) that synthesizes a compact justification and an automated fast-path for immediate revert (with snapshot and telemetry snapshot) when configured.
- Simulation harness (rehearsal/simulator.go and tests) to run a rehearsal locally or in CI with deterministic replay of sampled traffic and synthetic noise injection for stress scenarios.
- Integration tests (integration/rehearsal_smoke_test.go) and unit tests for concurrency/lease safety. Updated docs: docs/runway/rehearsal.md and examples/quickstarts/rehearsal.yml.

Commits (high-level):
- 7a2c9d: initial conductor scaffold and API surface; basic lease flow
- b4f1ee: add telemetry heuristics and safety scoring prototype
- d9e3aa: rollback oracle + snapshot/persist logic
- f2b44c: rehearsal simulator + deterministic replay + CI test harness
- 1c3a88: add integration tests, perf tuning to scheduler and buffer sizing
- e7f99b: docs and examples, test flake fixes

Files changed (high level):
- rehearsal/conductor.go: core conductor + lease orchestration + metrics
- rehearsal/simulator.go: deterministic replay harness, seeding and synthetic noise
- telemetry/heuristics.py: safety score computation and config knobs
- routing/lease_manager.go: traffic-lease implementation
- rollback/oracle.go: decision engine and snapshot wiring
- integration/rehearsal_smoke_test.go: end-to-end rehearsals in CI
- docs/runway/rehearsal.md: user-facing guide, safety knobs and recommended prompts

Testing and CI: The PR initially failed one CI job (integration/rehearsal_smoke_test) due to a race in lease expiry handling under heavy synthetic load (seen in local repro). I added a deterministic wait and an explicit lease refresh path; re-ran CI and all checks passed. Performance tests run on a small internal perf bench show median latency increase of <1% during rehearsal (shadow) runs and rehearsal CPU overhead under 5% for typical traffic shapes. The conductor has a conservative default config: rehearsal window=20s, sample_fraction=0.02, safety_threshold=0.85.

Review conversation (high-level):
- Evan Liu: requested stronger unit tests around concurrent lease renewals and explicit failure paths for oracle. Also asked to document how rehearsal interacts with Dedicated capacity autoscale. "Please add a deterministic repro for the race and make the lease refresh idempotent." Response: added simulator scenarios and made lease refresh idempotent (see commit 1c3a88).
- Carlos Ruiz: asked about blowup risk if rehearsals are scheduled concurrently for many models. Suggestion to add global rehearsal rate-limiter. Response: conductor now consults a global token-bucket and the default concurrency cap is 4 rehearsals per-region. See rehearsal/conductor.go config comments.
- Priya Menon: approval after verifying integration test plus a manual dry-run in staging with a small LLM where telemetry signatures triggered both pass and fail paths. "Nice to have: telemetry threshold tuning guide for SREs" — added to docs.

Backward/compatibility notes: The conductor registers a new rollout hook but is opt-in via rollout policy: only rollouts with "rehearsal: enabled" are affected. There are zero breaking API changes to existing rollout controllers. All new config entries have safe defaults.

Merge details: PR was approved by reviewers after two rounds of changes. CI green. Merged via squash by Priya Menon on 2024-10-10. Release notes (below) were added to the changelog.

Release notes:
- feature: Add Micro-Rehearsal Conductor to perform short shadow/replay rehearsals before traffic surges; configurable by rollout policy
- feature: Add traffic-lease to gate traffic fraction increases until safety heuristics pass
- feature: Rollback-oracle that recommends or triggers automated rollbacks when telemetry signatures indicate regressions
- docs: Rehearsal guide and example quickstart

Ops runbook highlights (excerpted into docs/runway/rehearsal.md):
- Where to adjust safety_threshold and sample_fraction for high-volume models
- How to force-void a stuck lease from the console
- How to interpret conductor telemetry (rehearsal_success_rate, safety_score_distribution, lease_wait_time)
release_notes:
- feature: Micro-Rehearsal Conductor (short rehearsal lanes + telemetry heuristics)
- feature: traffic-lease gating for safe surges
- feature: rollback-oracle with automated fast-path
- docs: rehearsal runbook and quickstart examples
review_thread_summary: Initial reviews highlighted a race in lease expiry and a scalability concern around concurrent rehearsals; both addressed by adding deterministic simulator tests, idempotent lease refresh, and a global rehearsal concurrency cap. Final approval after staging dry-run.
notes_for_sre: Default configs are conservative: rehearsal_window=20s, sample_fraction=0.02, safety_threshold=0.85. Consider lowering sample_fraction and increasing window for very high QPS models. Global rehearsal concurrency cap set to 4 per-region by default.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: rehearsals are opt-in and shadow-only by default; however misconfigured aggressive sample_fraction or concurrency could impact tail latencies. Defaults mitigate this. Rollback-oracle must be audited before enabling automated reverts in production.
